D.treatment: Spaced, repeated QStream case-based questions with feedback

O.outcome_detail: Self-reported knowledge of referral and genetic-testing guidelines

cells.quote: A majority of participants agreed that the program had helped them update their knowledge about referring women for assessment and consideration of genetic testing. Ten participants agreed that the program increased their knowledge and, as one participant noted, ‘a lot of the time we don’t actually learn why you would refer someone for genetics…so that was good and there were several genetic things that I thought that we shouldn’t do and it turned out that we should do’
cells.note: Knowledge change was assessed through semi-structured interviews at program completion; no objective knowledge test or randomized comparison was reported.

O.outcome_detail: referrals to family cancer clinics for genetic assessment/testing

result.effect: 1.8-fold increase at site A; 1.6-fold increase at site B

cells.quote: Overall, across the two sites, the number of women diagnosed with ovarian cancer that would be eligible for referral to an FCC in the two-time period was similar (97 pre and 110 post), as would be expected; however, there was a 1.8-fold increase in referrals at site A (26 referrals pre and 47 referrals post) and a 1.6-fold increase at site B (28 referrals pre and 46 referrals post).
cells.note: This was a nonrandomized comparison of 12-month pre- and post-program referral data; the authors cautioned that other factors may have contributed to the increase.

O.outcome_detail: acceptability and perceived suitability for disseminating updated guidelines

cells.quote: Eight of the 11 participants (73 %) interviewed affirmed that QStream is appropriate for disseminating new or updated clinical guidelines.
cells.note: The study reports qualitative acceptability, not a controlled comparison of delivery formats.

O.outcome_detail: self-reported intention to change referral patterns

cells.note: This is self-reported post-program practice change, not directly observed behavior.
